remarks: Nestled down on one of Darien's most sought after streets, this charming farmhouse offers five bedrooms, three full/one half bath, and lots of privacy. Sun filled interiors create a warm and inviting home a long with many different options to make this a dream property. Steps to Five Mile River and walking distance to Rowayton. Ideally located just minutes from town, train, beaches, this rare offering captures the essence of Darien's coastal lifestyle.
